authoring2.intro: Walk the case from AI draft to a signed, versioned publish. Step through the pipeline, lock each grounded fact, then co-sign to publish.

stepper.aria: Case authoring pipeline, six steppable stages

draft.heading: AI draft handoff
draft.sub: The model proposed the persona, case state, vitals drivers, and rubric. None of it is authoritative until a clinician grounds and locks it in the next stage.
draft.allLocked: Every drafted fact is already grounded and locked.
draft.tierNote: Drafted by a large open model, self-hosted and cross-family verified. No commercial vendor is named.

editor.groundAria: Ground and lock the flagged {{kind}} fact
editor.openHint: Accept the AI draft as locked, or edit it first. A locked fact carries its clinician provenance to the learner.
editor.groundHint: This claim could not be grounded to a cited source. Grounding it records a clinician edit and clears the publish block.
editor.ready: Every clinical fact is grounded and locked. Ready for sign-off.
editor.liveHashNote: Recomputed as facts change, frozen at sign-off.

signoff.liveHashNote: Live fingerprint, not yet frozen. Sign-off freezes it as the published version.
signoff.frozenNote: Frozen at sign-off. A learner encounter and its feedback pin to these hashes.
